opening.argument: The offer is presented as a conventional, free promotional giveaway for a $5 Target gift card, with the physical card visibly shown and no shipping charge. Entry requires viewers to subscribe, like, and comment, after which a winner is to be selected from the comments and contacted directly. Requesting a valid mailing address is described as the ordinary delivery step for that selected winner, while the available evidence does not connect the promotion to payment or credential collection. The title marks the giveaway as closed, although the record does not establish whether a winner was selected or whether the card was delivered.
